arrangement.name: tspm_center_2x2
arrangement.description: Tensor/tile-centric: main SRAM rows on the top and bottom edges as in periphery_rows; the TSPM macros as a 2x2 cluster in the core centre, upper pair pins up and lower pair pins down, so the vector/tensor logic can surround its scratchpad.
